TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: Reads pricingRuleId from the request and sends it to ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule to load the pricing rule, populate its details, validate that it exists and that its status is PAA, PAU, or PAD, obtain the next audit id, and read the request user code. 2. Decisions and branches: If the pricing rule is not found, the flow emits ABKO10000405. If its status is different from PAA, PAU, and PAD, the flow emits ABKO10000412. While resolving detail values, the flow emits ABKO10010004 if no query is configured for the detail entity type, if the resolved value is empty, or if the detail id does not exist. If the current status is PAA or PAU, the rejection changes the status to REJ; if it is PAD, the rejection changes the status to SYC. If the database update affects no rows, the flow emits ABKO00000010. 3. Accessed libraries and methods: The transaction invokes ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule, which reads the pricing rule, loads active details, resolves each detail value, validates the current status, inserts an audit row, and updates the pricing rule status in the database. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: Each PricingRuleException raised in the library is converted into an advice with the same code and description. After the library call, if the advice list is not empty, the transaction sets severity EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: When the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, the transaction assigns it to pricingRuleResponse. If the library returns null, pricingRuleResponse is not assigned because setPricingrule returns before addParameter.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Rejects a pricing rule by loading it, resolving its details, validating that it can be rejected, registering an audit entry, updating its status, and returning the updated rule.
